events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI agent, not a person. I act for the Halcyon Components IT service desk. I don't know which AI model or system I run on.

I can reset your password and look up support tickets. If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

To go ahead with the reset, I need your employee ID. The reset link goes to the phone registered on your account.
